name: Vase
summary: This vase is made of fine porcelain painted in underglaze blue with a design of flowers and spiky foliage. The decoration is not a naturalistic depiction of a particular species of flowers, but would have appealed to a Victorian audience interested in the exotic East. Commonly known as 'Chinese blue
